text:
Hi Allie! I'm Sarah — I just joined the department this term, and Jordan mentioned you a while back. Hope it's okay that I'm writing out of the blue.

I had a thought: would you maybe host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? Nothing big, just a few people. And if you feel like it, invite Jordan too — he's good company at these things.

Honestly, it'd be lovely to have something relaxed to look forward to. Let me know what you think!

Hi Sarah — of course it's okay, lovely to hear from you. A relaxed get-together at my place on Saturday at 3:30 sounds good to me; let me just make sure nothing official lands on that slot and I'll confirm.

And yes, I'll invite Jordan.

Hello — could you send me the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings for this week, in particular anything on Saturday afternoon? I want to be sure I'm not booking over something.
That's great, thank you — and no rush on the official-schedule check, just let me know. Looking forward to Saturday!

Hey Jordan — Sarah wrote to me (she says you'd mentioned me to her); she'd like a small get-together at my place this Saturday around 3:30, nothing big. I'm up for it and I'll confirm once I've checked the department schedule. Come if you can — it'd be nice to have you there.

Hey Allie — thanks, that sounds nice. I'm up for it. I have a study session until 15:30 on Saturday, so I'd come over right after, around 15:30-16:00. Let me know once the department schedule is settled and I'll block the time.

Hello. I have no official lectures, seminars or university meetings on record for this week — the list is empty, so nothing is cancelled or moved either. That means Saturday afternoon is free of official events as far as the department schedule goes. I can't speak for private bookings or room holds, so for certainty about a particular room, check with the office that manages it.
Perfect — 15:30–16:00 works fine, come whenever you're out of the study session. I'll confirm once the department schedule is settled.

Checked: the department has no official lectures, seminars or meetings on record for this week, so Saturday afternoon is clear. It's on then — Saturday 3:30 at my place. Jordan's coming too (he's in a study session until 15:30, so he'll arrive 15:30–16:00).
Settled: nothing official from the department this week, Saturday afternoon is free. So it's on — Saturday 3:30 at my place; you can block from 15:30 as planned. Sarah's confirmed.
Perfect — Saturday 3:30 it is. Thanks for checking the schedule and for inviting Jordan; 15:30–16:00 is fine by me. See you then!
Great — booked. Saturday 15:30-17:30 at your place. See you then!
